mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows operations with opResult != OpSuccess to carry an opAudit entry. The injected fact forces exactly this: a failed operation has an audit entry, directly violating AppendOnly and FR_016_NoAuditOnFailure.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some op : Operation | op.opResult = OpNotFound and some op.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CrossTeamNotFound allows an operation on a task in a different team to return OpSuccess, leaking the existence of cross-team tasks. The injected fact forces a cross-team operation to succeed.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeakViolation { some op : Operation | some op.opTask and op.opTask.taskTeam != op.opTeamCtx and op.opResult = OpSuccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilege allows a MemberNonOwner to successfully PATCH or DELETE a task they do not own. The injected fact forces this: a MemberNonOwner caller achieves OpSuccess on PatchTask, violating all three assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op : Operation | op.opCallerKind = MemberNonOwner and op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opResult = OpSuccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditPerSuccessfulMutation allows a successful DeleteTask to produce no audit entry. The injected fact forces a successful deletion with no audit record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op : Operation | op.opKind = DeleteTask and op.opResult = OpSuccess and no op.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AttributionCorrectness allows an audit entry to record a different actor or role than the operation that created it. The injected fact forces an audit entry whose aeActor differs from its owning operation's opActor.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op : Operation, u : User | some op.opAudit and op.opAudit.aeActor = u and u != op.opActor }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_TeamMembershipUnique allows two TeamMembership rows with the same (user, team) but different roles, violating the composite PK invariant that underpins per-team role resolution. The injected fact forces duplicate (user, team) memberships.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateMembershipViolation { some disj m1, m2 : TeamMembership | m1.mbUser = m2.mbUser and m1.mbTeam = m2.mbTeam and m1.mbRole != m2.mbRole }
